source: Money Rooms v3 Level 8 spec: the call path

stops.label: Confirm
stops.title: What you told me
stops.intro: Let us start with what you told me on our first call. Still right, or has anything changed?
stops.guessIntro: These are averages for your area, not your numbers. Want to swap any for yours?

stops.label: What you spend
stops.title: What you spend
stops.intro: Without looking anything up: what do you think goes out in a normal month?
stops.areaPrompt: About how much a month goes to {area}?
stops.sharedPrompt: Is that the whole bill or your part?

stops.label: What you'd want
stops.title: What you'd want
stops.intro: Forget what it costs today. If this part of your life were working the way you want, what would it cost a month?
stops.areaPrompt: If {area} were working the way you want, what would it cost a month?
stops.housingChoice: For home: with a roommate, or on your own?
stops.fiAge: At what age would you want work to be optional?

stops.label: The real numbers
stops.title: The real numbers
stops.intro: Now the real numbers, one line at a time. Statements or the app home screen are enough.
stops.homework: Before next time, gather one month of statements. We will walk through them together next session.

stops.label: How far off
stops.title: How far off
stops.intro: Here is what you said, what it really is, and what you would want.
stops.gentleHold: We will look at this once you have gathered the real numbers yourself.

stops.label: Your targets
stops.title: Your targets
stops.intro: For each area, pick the number you want to aim for. Your words, not mine.
